repos.name: Veritas_Website
repos.description: Pre-release site for Veritas: Master what you read.

repos.name: LLM_Application
repos.description: Explores how to apply large language models (LLMs) to healthcare using prompt engineering techniques like in-context learning and reasoning chains. Uses synthetic medical datasets to generate predictions, simplify medical text, and evaluate summarization. Delivered as a Python notebook and slides.

repos.name: MIMIC_Visualization
repos.description: A visual storytelling project using MIMIC-III/IV EHR data. Includes five Python-generated figures created with Matplotlib and Seaborn to explore trends in patient, admission, and diagnosis data. Accompanied by slides that explain each visualization with code, insights, and reproducible methods.

repos.name: MIMIC_SQL
repos.description: SQL-based exploration of MIMIC-III/IV EHR data, featuring 10 queries with JOINs, GROUP BY, and nested SELECTs. Highlights meaningful healthcare stats (e.g., medications, length of stay, readmission). Includes slide deck with query explanations, results, and interpretations for clinical data analysis.

repos.name: MIMIC_NLP
repos.description: A tutorial applying modern NLP tools (Spacy, SciSpacy) to MIMIC-III medical notes for clinical concept extraction. Includes entity recognition, word embeddings, and t-SNE visualizations. Additional exploration of advanced models like BERT. Fully documented in a Jupyter notebook with teaching slides.

repos.name: LOS_Prediction
repos.description: A self-guided ML tutorial using MIMIC-III EHR data to predict patient length of stay. Includes data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation, with fully commented Python code and step-by-step slides for teaching. Designed to build and communicate healthcare ML workflows effectively.

repos.name: MIMIC_ML_DL
repos.description: Applies machine learning and deep learning to MIMIC EHR data for healthcare prediction tasks. Includes feature extraction, model fitting, and evaluation across various ML/DL methods beyond standard tutorials. Delivered with a Jupyter notebook and slides detailing methods, results, and insights.

repos.name: Gallify_Website
repos.description: Launch website for Gallify, an AR/VR marketplace, built with HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Features include sign-up and a responsive UI/UX.

repos.name: UWCS_Alumni_Website
repos.description: Alumni website for University of Wisconsin–Madison, built with HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Features include sign-up, events, and a responsive UI/UX.

repos.name: Gallify_App
repos.description: Gallify is an immersive AR/VR marketplace platform designed for digital artists and collectors. Built with a focus on user experience and spatial interaction, it enables creators to showcase, sell, and explore virtual art in 3D environments—bridging the gap between technology, design, and digital curation.
